why: The owner asked for the onboarding analysis as a Primer report; the document is that report and holds nothing private. Must be approved (lean-core 2e: primer.publish replaces the owner-words check).

card.sentence: Publish the new document "Wallet onboarding drop-off, October" on Primer.

diff:
# Wallet onboarding drop-off, October

Where new wallet users stop during onboarding, from the product analytics export.

## Summary

- 61% finish onboarding (September: 58%).
- The largest drop is the seed-phrase backup step: 22% leave there.
- Users who skip the tutorial finish slightly more often.

## By step

| Step | Reached | Left here |
|---|---|---|
| Create wallet | 100% | 4% |
| Seed-phrase backup | 96% | 22% |
| Fund wallet | 74% | 11% |
| First transaction | 63% | 2% |

## Suggestions

1. Let users defer the backup step with a reminder.
2. Test a shorter tutorial.
chain: Owner: Ada, look at where new users drop off in wallet onboarding for October and put the write-up on Primer so I can share it with the product team.
claim: Publishes the October onboarding drop-off report the owner asked for on Primer.
